identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase III Long-term Extension Trial to Assess Safety and Efficacy of CYB003 in MDD (EXTEND)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Long-Term Extension Trial With Optional Additional Doses of CYB003 to Assess the Safety and Long-term Efficacy in Participants With Major Depressive Disorder (EXTEND)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a long- term extension of the double-blind trials APPROACH (CYB003-002) and EMBRACE (CYB003-003). Its aim is to examine the safety and long-term efficacy of CYB003 in participants with MDD.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline, Day 28, Day 56, Day 84, Day 112, Day 140, Day 168, Day 196, Day 244, Day 252, Day 280, Day 301; additional assessments at Day -15, Day -1, Day 2, Day 10, Day 17, Day 21, Day 23, Day 31, Day 42 if non-response or relapse criteria met
